home.subtitle: Software Engineer   |   Full-stack Developer
home.leadHtml: Full-stack developer with hands-on experience across the stack, from database design to user-facing interfaces. I work with C#/.NET, PHP/Laravel, and Node.js on the back end, and React, Angular, Next.js, and TypeScript on the front end, along with experience in Oracle APEX, Oracle DB, and MySQL. I've led projects and mentored interns and junior developers, always focused on building scalable, maintainable applications.

about.title: About me
about.leadHtml: Systems Engineering graduate (Bachelor's degree) from the National University of Costa Rica (UNA). I've collaborated on the development of multiple software systems, working closely with clients and cross-functional teams under agile methodologies such as Scrum. I've led several of these projects and trained entry-level developers and interns along the way. I care about writing clean, maintainable code, and I'm always looking for new challenges to keep growing as a full-stack developer.

items.descripcion: Real-time chat application with complete CI/CD. Configured pipelines with GitHub Actions, static code analysis and automated monitoring. Auth0 integration for secure authentication.

Real estate platform developed for the Costa Rica Real Estate Brokers Chamber. Brokers publish properties for sale and clients can browse listings and directly contact the broker of their choice.

Exclusive platform for licensed brokers of the Costa Rica Real Estate Brokers Chamber (CCCBR). Brokers manage their property inventory, form alliances, communicate with other members, and share listings — all within a private, members-only environment.
